notes: Re-baselined 2026-08-26 after HI1031/HI1032 flashcards were pruned to course-relevant scope (vault backlog F60): 41 published notes removed. pages 693->652, pagesWithCallouts 442->401, questionCallouts 2476->2241, internalLinks 40892->38428, brokenInternalLinks 85->74; cardLeakPages/imagesWithoutAlt/katexErrorPages still 0.

COORDINATION: this baseline matches the PRUNED vault, so it must go live together with the vault-prune push. Push the vault first, then this repo (or use workflow_dispatch after both). An interim scheduled build of the still-old vault clears the growth checks (higher pages/callouts) but would trip the no-rise check on brokenInternalLinks (85 > 74), so keep the two pushes inside the hourly deploy cadence.

'pages' counts DISTINCT CASE-INSENSITIVE routes, not raw .html files: Quartz emits an original-cased redirect stub beside each lowercase slug, so Linux keeps both files and NTFS collapses each pair, yet both platforms report the same route count. See tools/lib/page-count.mjs and vault backlog F59.
brokenInternalLinks is a ceiling that must never rise; the links are overwhelmingly into deliberately-unpublished Litteraturlista PDFs plus the unpublished HT100X degree project.
